key_insights: BTC and ETH have both broken their 200-week moving averages on a closing basis, which is historically bearish
The market has experienced zero relief in a 10-11 week downtrend from 48k to 17-18k
A failed breakdown (reclaim above 200-week MA) would create significant upside momentum as trapped sellers are forced to buy back
Macro factors (inflation, tightening cycle, geopolitics) remain the primary driver and are still negative
Weekend selling with low liquidity may have tainted the weekly close, suggesting forced selling and deleveraging
summary: BTC and ETH have both broken their critical 200-week moving averages around $22k and $1k respectively, signaling bearish conditions. However, Cred is waiting for evidence of a failed breakdown via a reclaim of these levels, which would trigger counter-trend longs targeting $28-32k on BTC and $1,400-2,000 on ETH. If breakdowns continue, monthly support at $11-14k (BTC) and $700-400 (ETH) represents existential buy levels. Macro remains negative, but a temporary bounce could occur if the 200-week MA is reclaimed.
